turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must say, Your Majesty, that I am intrigued by the gravity of the situation. Might I be so bold as to ask what specific action you hope we can take to mitigate this potential scandal?

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Your Majesty, the stakes are clear: a potentially devastating scandal that could impact European politics. I require more information to grasp the situation's complexities.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear that I may have placed myself and those I hold dear in a precarious position, Your Majesties. The circumstances are... delicate, and I dare not speak of them freely, lest I compromise the safety of those involved.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Your Majesty, I observe that you are hesitant to reveal the details of this scandal, which suggests to me that you are not merely concerned about your own reputation, but also about the welfare of those involved.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I implore you, gentlemen, to understand that the fate of those I love hangs in the balance. I dare not reveal more, lest I put them in greater peril.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Your Majesty, I must confess that I am beginning to piece together the situation, and I share Sherlock's concern for the welfare of those involved. Might I suggest that we proceed with caution, and that you, with our guidance, take steps to mitigate the potential harm, rather than allowing the situation to unfold unchecked?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I concur with Dr. Watson's suggestion, gentlemen. With your expertise and discretion, I propose that we work together to... to mitigate the consequences of this scandal.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must insist, Your Majesty, that we clarify the situation as quickly as possible, lest we squander the narrow window of opportunity that exists to rectify the situation.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear that the situation is more complex than I initially intimated, and that there are those who would seek to exploit it for their own gain, to the detriment of all involved. Might I request, gentlemen, that you remain discreet regarding our conversation, lest...

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Your Majesty, I must press you for more information regarding these individuals who would seek to exploit the situation. Their identities and motivations are crucial to understanding the full scope of the problem.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear that to reveal too much at this time may prove... unwise, gentlemen. I can only assure you that the consequences of this scandal would be far-reaching, with repercussions that could destabilize the balance of power in Europe.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must insist, Your Majesty, that you reveal more information about these individuals and their motivations, lest we proceed under false assumptions and compromise our chances of success.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must insist, Your Majesty, that you reveal at least some details about these individuals, as Sherlock's and my abilities to assist you depend on a clear understanding of the situation.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I beg of you, gentlemen, to consider the delicate nature of the information I have shared with you thus far. I fear that to reveal more may compromise not only my own position, but also the trust placed in me by those who have confided in me.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Your Majesty, I must stress that our primary concern is to uncover the truth and assist you in resolving this crisis. I assure you that our conversation will remain confidential, and we will proceed with utmost discretion.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I warn you, Your Majesty, that the longer you delay revealing the essential details, the greater the risk of our investigation being compromised or even manipulated by those who seek to exploit the situation.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I assure you, gentlemen, that the stakes are higher than you can possibly imagine, and the consequences of failure would be catastrophic not only for me, but for the entire continent.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Your Majesty, I understand the gravity of the situation, but I must press you for more information. We cannot assist you effectively without knowing the specifics of the case.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must say, Your Majesty, that your caution is justified, but it also suggests that you are withholding crucial information. I implore you to trust my analytical mind and the discretion of Dr. Watson, and reveal the essential details of this crisis.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I beg of you, gentlemen, to understand that I am not merely being cautious, but I am bound by a solemn obligation to protect the interests of my...ahem...family. I fear that if the wrong information falls into the wrong hands, it could lead to irreparable harm.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: I told you that I would call.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: It is both, or none. You may say before this gentleman anything which you may say to me.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Then I must begin, by binding you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Our visitor glanced with some apparent surprise at the languid, lounging figure of the man who had been no doubt depicted to him as the most incisive reasoner and most energetic agent in Europe. Holmes slowly reopened his eyes and looked impatiently at his gigantic client.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?
